text:
carmen-fin: FYI — spotted a pricing experiment surge that bypassed the grandfathering rule for a small cohort. 3 customers hit the new price instead of preserved tier. getting support emails. tagging billing/ops.

matt-ops: Can you drop examples? invoice IDs or customer IDs will help.

carmen-fin: INV-2025-04-12-9087, INV-2025-04-12-9088, cust: ACME-42. Appears credits/legacy flag didn't apply during ingest.

sophia-revops: pulling the experiment logs now. quick note: the experiment variant had a `price_override` and a separate `preserve_legacy_flag` — might be a mapping issue.

lee-eng: we pushed the new price sheet parser yesterday afternoon. quick check: sample header looks like this:```
customer_id,plan_code,price_usd,preserve_legacy,experiment_bucket
ACME-42,pro,0.12,true,B
```

lee-eng: if `preserve_legacy` was omitted for a row it defaults to false. I'll check the ingest pipeline for missing column fallbacks.

matt-ops: I can run a targeted backfill to reapply `preserve_legacy=true` for affected customers and queue credits. suggest: dry-run -> review -> apply. I'll take ownership of the backfill. planning to run at 11:30 PST.

billing-bot: Automated alert: refund queued for INV-2025-04-12-9087 amount $12.45. Status: pending_manual_review.

sophia-revops: If the backfill creates credits > $500 please loop in @tara-legal for approval/communication signoff. Also need a short customer note template — I'll draft one.

carmen-fin: Good. Matt: post dry-run output here and tag me. Lee: please open a patch PR for parser fallback + add a schema validation step on import so missing `preserve_legacy` fails loudly.

lee-eng: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/price-ingest/pulls/324 — adds explicit schema check and clearer logging. I'll wait for matt's dry-run before merging.

matt-ops: Dry-run started at 11:30 PST. Command: `./bin/backfill-preserve --invoices INV-2025-04-12-9087,9088 --dry-run` Output (snippet):
```
2025-04-14T19:30:01Z INFO -> scanning 2 invoices
2025-04-14T19:30:02Z INFO -> 1 invoice flagged for manual review (amt > $500)
2025-04-14T19:30:03Z INFO -> 1 invoice eligible for automatic credit: INV-2025-04-12-9087 -> $12.45
```

matt-ops: Dry-run looks clean. I'll schedule the real run at 12:15 PST unless anyone objects.

sophia-revops: no objections. I'll prepare the customer communications template and a short FAQ for CSMs.

tara-legal: keeping an eye. if any customer requests expedited settlements, escalate to me.

carmen-fin: thanks all. After the run, let's capture a short postmortem with root cause and the mitigation steps (parser schema + backfill runbook). I'll kick off the postmortem doc and assign owners. :eyes:
